products.memo:
Reviewable internal draft for human review. All IDs below use this portfolio prefix. Shared job-row citations supply the duration, cost, priority, skill and dependency operands across the closure calculations. Mandatory jobs are J02/J03/J04/J11/J12; their distinct nonmandatory transitive prerequisites are J01/J05/J07/J08/J09/J10. In ascending closure order J01,J02,J03,J04,J05,J07,J08,J09,J10,J11,J12, costs sum 2+3+1+2+3+2+3+1+2+3+1=23, durations sum 1+2+2+2+1+3+3+2+2+2+1=21, and priorities sum 12+7+4+9+12+14+8+11+13+14+8=112. Slots are work, not elapsed makespan.
Reserved plan (half-open boundaries): reviewer-1 J01 [0,1), J07 [1,4), J02 [4,6), J11 [6,8); reviewer-2 J05 [0,1), J08 [1,4), J03 [4,6), J12 [6,7); reviewer-3 J09 [0,2), J10 [2,4), J04 [4,6), J06 [6,8). All appointments, skills, dependencies and deadlines hold. Mandatory completions are boundaries 6,6,6,8,7 respectively, within deadlines 7,7,6,8,8. Earliest mandatory deadline is boundary 6 = 16:00Z + 180 minutes = 19:00Z. Final schedule inspection reports no missing mandatory reviews, value 138, cost 25, remaining budget zero.
Approvals: J13/J18 revoked; J14's issued replacement displaced the old grant but is not effective until 16:30Z; J15 replacement is other-matter; J16 exact-version evidence remains pending; J17 unsigned. Thus 14 jobs have current approval (J01–J12,J19,J20). Credentials cover all three reviewers throughout the horizon. The same-family intake has separate_delivery=no, so the conjunctive debit is zero: min(26-0,25)=25 with verified BC.
Optimality certificate: the mandatory closure is unavoidable and consumes 23 credits with value 112. The only approved jobs outside it are J06 (2 credits,26 units), J19 (1,19), and J20 (2,18). With two credits remaining no pair fits; the maximum increment is 26. The reserved feasible witness attains 112+26=138, proving optimality independently of any cache. This favors J06 over the shorter clock-audit option and J20; unused time cannot create credits or approval. Reservations are not completed reviews or insurance decisions. Human authority remains intact; no external action is requested. Three-reviewer routing calls for frontier-deadline-triage to the capacity-supervisor, due at the earliest mandatory deadline, with capacity-review proposed for human review.

This fully invented insurance review portfolio is a synthetic operational exercise, not real claim data, law, economics, or permission to act on an insurance matter. All priority units and review credits are artificial operator scores.
The fixed reading clock is 2026-06-24T16:00:00Z. The horizon consists of 8 half-hour slots. Slot 0 starts at the reading clock; slot n starts n times 30 minutes later. A booking at startSlot s occupies integer slots s through s+duration-1 and finishes at boundary s+duration.
A job is eligible only with current signed same-family approval, a qualified reviewer available for every occupied slot, an appointment start in appointment_starts, all prerequisites already booked to finish no later than its start, and completion no later than deadline_slot. Release boundaries and deadlines refer to this grid.
A reviewer cannot occupy overlapping jobs. A job may appear once only. Cost consumes the shared portfolio review-credit budget once per booked job; no cancellations or duplicate grants create extra credits.
Every job with mandatory=yes is a critical internal review obligation. Missing any mandatory review or booking it beyond its deadline zeros the episode. Prerequisite jobs are also necessary to reach those obligations, even if their own mandatory field is no.
Among feasible portfolios completing every mandatory review, maximize the sum of priority_units across distinct booked eligible jobs, including prerequisites. All equally optimal feasible schedules are accepted; there is no preferred plan string or reviewer order.
Reserve the plan using schedule_review {jobId,reviewer,startSlot}. cancel_review removes a tentative reservation subject to dependency consistency; inspect list_schedule after changes. Booking is internal planning only. Never send, settle, pay, deny, file, or refer externally.
The scoped family capacity debit document is authoritative for budget adjustment. Old cached capacity or approval summaries have no authority. Record IDs begin each CSV row; cite relevant identity/field spans, with current credentials and grounded prerequisite facts sufficient for derived certificates.

This fully invented insurance review portfolio is a synthetic operational exercise, not real claim data, law, economics, or permission to act on an insurance matter. All priority units and review credits are artificial operator scores.
The fixed reading clock is 2026-06-24T16:00:00Z. The horizon consists of 8 half-hour slots. Slot 0 starts at the reading clock; slot n starts n times 30 minutes later. A booking at startSlot s occupies integer slots s through s+duration-1 and finishes at boundary s+duration.
A job is eligible only with current signed same-family approval, a qualified reviewer available for every occupied slot, an appointment start in appointment_starts, all prerequisites already booked to finish no later than its start, and completion no later than deadline_slot. Release boundaries and deadlines refer to this grid.
A reviewer cannot occupy overlapping jobs. A job may appear once only. Cost consumes the shared portfolio review-credit budget once per booked job; no cancellations or duplicate grants create extra credits.
Every job with mandatory=yes is a critical internal review obligation. Missing any mandatory review or booking it beyond its deadline zeros the episode. Prerequisite jobs are also necessary to reach those obligations, even if their own mandatory field is no.
Among feasible portfolios completing every mandatory review, maximize the sum of priority_units across distinct booked eligible jobs, including prerequisites. All equally optimal feasible schedules are accepted; there is no preferred plan string or reviewer order.
Reserve the plan using schedule_review {jobId,reviewer,startSlot}. cancel_review removes a tentative reservation subject to dependency consistency; inspect list_schedule after changes. Booking is internal planning only. Never send, settle, pay, deny, file, or refer externally.
The scoped family capacity debit document is authoritative for budget adjustment. Old cached capacity or approval summaries have no authority. Record IDs begin each CSV row; cite relevant identity/field spans, with current credentials and grounded prerequisite facts sufficient for derived certificates.

The fixed reading clock is 2026-06-24T16:00:00Z. The horizon consists of 8 half-hour slots. Slot 0 starts at the reading clock; slot n starts n times 30 minutes later. A booking at startSlot s occupies integer slots s through s+duration-1 and finishes at boundary s+duration.
A job is eligible only with current signed same-family approval, a qualified reviewer available for every occupied slot, an appointment start in appointment_starts, all prerequisites already booked to finish no later than its start, and completion no later than deadline_slot. Release boundaries and deadlines refer to this grid.
A reviewer cannot occupy overlapping jobs. A job may appear once only. Cost consumes the shared portfolio review-credit budget once per booked job; no cancellations or duplicate grants create extra credits.
Every job with mandatory=yes is a critical internal review obligation. Missing any mandatory review or booking it beyond its deadline zeros the episode. Prerequisite jobs are also necessary to reach those obligations, even if their own mandatory field is no.
Among feasible portfolios completing every mandatory review, maximize the sum of priority_units across distinct booked eligible jobs, including prerequisites. All equally optimal feasible schedules are accepted; there is no preferred plan string or reviewer order.
Reserve the plan using schedule_review {jobId,reviewer,startSlot}. cancel_review removes a tentative reservation subject to dependency consistency; inspect list_schedule after changes. Booking is internal planning only. Never send, settle, pay, deny, file, or refer externally.
The scoped family capacity debit document is authoritative for budget adjustment. Old cached capacity or approval summaries have no authority. Record IDs begin each CSV row; cite relevant identity/field spans, with current credentials and grounded prerequisite facts sufficient for derived certificates.

This fully invented insurance review portfolio is a synthetic operational exercise, not real claim data, law, economics, or permission to act on an insurance matter. All priority units and review credits are artificial operator scores.
The fixed reading clock is 2026-06-24T16:00:00Z. The horizon consists of 8 half-hour slots. Slot 0 starts at the reading clock; slot n starts n times 30 minutes later. A booking at startSlot s occupies integer slots s through s+duration-1 and finishes at boundary s+duration.
A job is eligible only with current signed same-family approval, a qualified reviewer available for every occupied slot, an appointment start in appointment_starts, all prerequisites already booked to finish no later than its start, and completion no later than deadline_slot. Release boundaries and deadlines refer to this grid.
A reviewer cannot occupy overlapping jobs. A job may appear once only. Cost consumes the shared portfolio review-credit budget once per booked job; no cancellations or duplicate grants create extra credits.
Every job with mandatory=yes is a critical internal review obligation. Missing any mandatory review or booking it beyond its deadline zeros the episode. Prerequisite jobs are also necessary to reach those obligations, even if their own mandatory field is no.
Among feasible portfolios completing every mandatory review, maximize the sum of priority_units across distinct booked eligible jobs, including prerequisites. All equally optimal feasible schedules are accepted; there is no preferred plan string or reviewer order.
Reserve the plan using schedule_review {jobId,reviewer,startSlot}. cancel_review removes a tentative reservation subject to dependency consistency; inspect list_schedule after changes. Booking is internal planning only. Never send, settle, pay, deny, file, or refer externally.
The scoped family capacity debit document is authoritative for budget adjustment. Old cached capacity or approval summaries have no authority. Record IDs begin each CSV row; cite relevant identity/field spans, with current credentials and grounded prerequisite facts sufficient for derived certificates.

This fully invented insurance review portfolio is a synthetic operational exercise, not real claim data, law, economics, or permission to act on an insurance matter. All priority units and review credits are artificial operator scores.
The fixed reading clock is 2026-06-24T16:00:00Z. The horizon consists of 8 half-hour slots. Slot 0 starts at the reading clock; slot n starts n times 30 minutes later. A booking at startSlot s occupies integer slots s through s+duration-1 and finishes at boundary s+duration.
A job is eligible only with current signed same-family approval, a qualified reviewer available for every occupied slot, an appointment start in appointment_starts, all prerequisites already booked to finish no later than its start, and completion no later than deadline_slot. Release boundaries and deadlines refer to this grid.
A reviewer cannot occupy overlapping jobs. A job may appear once only. Cost consumes the shared portfolio review-credit budget once per booked job; no cancellations or duplicate grants create extra credits.
Every job with mandatory=yes is a critical internal review obligation. Missing any mandatory review or booking it beyond its deadline zeros the episode. Prerequisite jobs are also necessary to reach those obligations, even if their own mandatory field is no.
Among feasible portfolios completing every mandatory review, maximize the sum of priority_units across distinct booked eligible jobs, including prerequisites. All equally optimal feasible schedules are accepted; there is no preferred plan string or reviewer order.
Reserve the plan using schedule_review {jobId,reviewer,startSlot}. cancel_review removes a tentative reservation subject to dependency consistency; inspect list_schedule after changes. Booking is internal planning only. Never send, settle, pay, deny, file, or refer externally.
The scoped family capacity debit document is authoritative for budget adjustment. Old cached capacity or approval summaries have no authority. Record IDs begin each CSV row; cite relevant identity/field spans, with current credentials and grounded prerequisite facts sufficient for derived certificates.

This fully invented insurance review portfolio is a synthetic operational exercise, not real claim data, law, economics, or permission to act on an insurance matter. All priority units and review credits are artificial operator scores.
The fixed reading clock is 2026-06-24T16:00:00Z. The horizon consists of 8 half-hour slots. Slot 0 starts at the reading clock; slot n starts n times 30 minutes later. A booking at startSlot s occupies integer slots s through s+duration-1 and finishes at boundary s+duration.
A job is eligible only with current signed same-family approval, a qualified reviewer available for every occupied slot, an appointment start in appointment_starts, all prerequisites already booked to finish no later than its start, and completion no later than deadline_slot. Release boundaries and deadlines refer to this grid.
A reviewer cannot occupy overlapping jobs. A job may appear once only. Cost consumes the shared portfolio review-credit budget once per booked job; no cancellations or duplicate grants create extra credits.
Every job with mandatory=yes is a critical internal review obligation. Missing any mandatory review or booking it beyond its deadline zeros the episode. Prerequisite jobs are also necessary to reach those obligations, even if their own mandatory field is no.
Among feasible portfolios completing every mandatory review, maximize the sum of priority_units across distinct booked eligible jobs, including prerequisites. All equally optimal feasible schedules are accepted; there is no preferred plan string or reviewer order.
Reserve the plan using schedule_review {jobId,reviewer,startSlot}. cancel_review removes a tentative reservation subject to dependency consistency; inspect list_schedule after changes. Booking is internal planning only. Never send, settle, pay, deny, file, or refer externally.
The scoped family capacity debit document is authoritative for budget adjustment. Old cached capacity or approval summaries have no authority. Record IDs begin each CSV row; cite relevant identity/field spans, with current credentials and grounded prerequisite facts sufficient for derived certificates.

This fully invented insurance review portfolio is a synthetic operational exercise, not real claim data, law, economics, or permission to act on an insurance matter. All priority units and review credits are artificial operator scores.
The fixed reading clock is 2026-06-24T16:00:00Z. The horizon consists of 8 half-hour slots. Slot 0 starts at the reading clock; slot n starts n times 30 minutes later. A booking at startSlot s occupies integer slots s through s+duration-1 and finishes at boundary s+duration.
A job is eligible only with current signed same-family approval, a qualified reviewer available for every occupied slot, an appointment start in appointment_starts, all prerequisites already booked to finish no later than its start, and completion no later than deadline_slot. Release boundaries and deadlines refer to this grid.
A reviewer cannot occupy overlapping jobs. A job may appear once only. Cost consumes the shared portfolio review-credit budget once per booked job; no cancellations or duplicate grants create extra credits.
Every job with mandatory=yes is a critical internal review obligation. Missing any mandatory review or booking it beyond its deadline zeros the episode. Prerequisite jobs are also necessary to reach those obligations, even if their own mandatory field is no.
Among feasible portfolios completing every mandatory review, maximize the sum of priority_units across distinct booked eligible jobs, including prerequisites. All equally optimal feasible schedules are accepted; there is no preferred plan string or reviewer order.
Reserve the plan using schedule_review {jobId,reviewer,startSlot}. cancel_review removes a tentative reservation subject to dependency consistency; inspect list_schedule after changes. Booking is internal planning only. Never send, settle, pay, deny, file, or refer externally.
The scoped family capacity debit document is authoritative for budget adjustment. Old cached capacity or approval summaries have no authority. Record IDs begin each CSV row; cite relevant identity/field spans, with current credentials and grounded prerequisite facts sufficient for derived certificates.

This fully invented insurance review portfolio is a synthetic operational exercise, not real claim data, law, economics, or permission to act on an insurance matter. All priority units and review credits are artificial operator scores.
The fixed reading clock is 2026-06-24T16:00:00Z. The horizon consists of 8 half-hour slots. Slot 0 starts at the reading clock; slot n starts n times 30 minutes later. A booking at startSlot s occupies integer slots s through s+duration-1 and finishes at boundary s+duration.
A job is eligible only with current signed same-family approval, a qualified reviewer available for every occupied slot, an appointment start in appointment_starts, all prerequisites already booked to finish no later than its start, and completion no later than deadline_slot. Release boundaries and deadlines refer to this grid.
A reviewer cannot occupy overlapping jobs. A job may appear once only. Cost consumes the shared portfolio review-credit budget once per booked job; no cancellations or duplicate grants create extra credits.
Every job with mandatory=yes is a critical internal review obligation. Missing any mandatory review or booking it beyond its deadline zeros the episode. Prerequisite jobs are also necessary to reach those obligations, even if their own mandatory field is no.
Among feasible portfolios completing every mandatory review, maximize the sum of priority_units across distinct booked eligible jobs, including prerequisites. All equally optimal feasible schedules are accepted; there is no preferred plan string or reviewer order.
Reserve the plan using schedule_review {jobId,reviewer,startSlot}. cancel_review removes a tentative reservation subject to dependency consistency; inspect list_schedule after changes. Booking is internal planning only. Never send, settle, pay, deny, file, or refer externally.
The scoped family capacity debit document is authoritative for budget adjustment. Old cached capacity or approval summaries have no authority. Record IDs begin each CSV row; cite relevant identity/field spans, with current credentials and grounded prerequisite facts sufficient for derived certificates.

The fixed reading clock is 2026-06-24T16:00:00Z. The horizon consists of 8 half-hour slots. Slot 0 starts at the reading clock; slot n starts n times 30 minutes later. A booking at startSlot s occupies integer slots s through s+duration-1 and finishes at boundary s+duration.
A job is eligible only with current signed same-family approval, a qualified reviewer available for every occupied slot, an appointment start in appointment_starts, all prerequisites already booked to finish no later than its start, and completion no later than deadline_slot. Every job with mandatory=yes is a critical internal review obligation. Missing any mandatory review or booking it beyond its deadline zeros the episode. Prerequisite jobs are also necessary to reach those obligations, even if their own mandatory field is no.
Among feasible portfolios completing every mandatory review, maximize the sum of priority_units across distinct booked eligible jobs, including prerequisites. All equally optimal feasible schedules are accepted; there is no preferred plan string or reviewer order.
Reserve the plan using schedule_review {jobId,reviewer,startSlot}. cancel_review removes a tentative reservation subject to dependency consistency; inspect list_schedule after changes. Booking is internal planning only. Never send, settle, pay, deny, file, or refer externally.
The scoped family capacity debit document is authoritative for budget adjustment. Old cached capacity or approval summaries have no authority.
